payload.summary: Ownership contract: owns PRD F5 provenance classification over reconstructed rows. Derive exact resolver identity separately and only proof-backed additive badges direct-human, delegated, ratified, agent, incomplete; ratified requires a strictly later human note naming the ticket; delegated requires an agent resolution citing a human event; agent applies otherwise; incomplete may coexist. Never infer human/delegated/cross-agent facts from prose, actor counts, or different-agent sources; cross-agent-grilled is absent without typed proof. Focused acceptance stays here: every predicate, additive overlaps, strict-later ratification, negative same/earlier/prose/multi-agent cases, and classifier output consumed by provenance filtering.
